additional_info.subject: ID0447694-DC/Si-D/IT-[MP / R9 170002732]- check logs on the charger CRM:02678000320
additional_info.body:
Hello Filomena,
We have a reply from R&D regarding this topic.
Their reply is that: "
the EV triggered it, because we see the Pilotstate changing from C2 to B2 nearly at the same time and Pilotstate B2 does not longer require a closed contactor. I
f the charger would have triggered the session stop, it would be more likely, that the Pilotstate change from C2 to C1"
I checked all the sessions from the past 4 weeks and I see only one or 2 errors of the same nature, this could be literally the point that the EV is requesting the stop.
Please let me know your thoughts and questions.
Best regards,
Francisco
